description: This file defines an abstract base class 'GraphicsUnitBase' that provides utilities for handling graphics units in PDF rendering, including font definitions and size conversions based on different units.

classes.name: GraphicsUnitBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing utilities for handling and converting graphics units within PDF rendering context.

methods.name: CalcSizeForGraphics
methods.description: Converts a size value into a different graphics unit, returning the size in the specified unit.
